subject: Evidence transport checklist, transfer method options & fallback policy
messages:
From: Susan Martin <susan.martin@northriver.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: admin activity export options + legal-hold window

Hi Logan,

We're preparing for an upcoming SIG assessment and our auditors have asked for an admin-activity export (operator actions, role changes, API key events, session start/stop) covering a 30-day window plus a 90-day legal-hold window. Can you confirm:

- What specific event classes are included in your admin activity feed (short list)?
- Retention granularity (per-event timestamps, actor id, resource id, pre/post-change payloads)?
- Export delivery options (SFTP, HTTPS upload, PGP-signed bundles, streaming webhooks)?
- Checksums and attestation options (signed manifest, HMAC, timestamped S3 links)?

We have a PO attached for the one-off export. Also need to understand your fallback policy if the primary transfer method fails during the export.

Thanks,
Susan
Director, Security & Compliance
Northriver Health

Attachment: northriver_PO_20260224.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Susan Martin <susan.martin@northriver.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity export options + legal-hold window

Hi Susan — thanks for the PO and clear ask. High-level answers below and a short transport checklist attached.

Event classes included (export scope):
- operator.auth (login/logout, MFA challenges)
- operator.admin_change (role grants/revokes, permission edits)
- operator.api_key (create/rotate/revoke API keys)
- operator.session (session_start/session_end, session_timeout)
- system.config (deploys, model pinning, rollout changes)

Each exported record includes: RFC3339 timestamp, internal actor id (hashed if requested), resource id, pre-change and post-change payloads for admin_change events, and an event_id.

Retention & granularity:
- Raw admin activity retained in our audit store for 13 months by default.
- We can produce timeboxed snapshots (arbitrary windows) and apply per-field redaction on request.

Delivery options (we support all of these):
1) SFTP push to your inbound host (preferred for large bundles) — delivered as compressed jsonl + detached PGP signature or ASC-signed checksum.
2) HTTPS PUT (customer-managed endpoint) — TLS mutual auth available.
3) Temporarily provisioned secure object store (pre-signed S3) with signed manifest and timestamped attestation.
4) Streaming websocket/webhook for incremental delivery (useful for real-time ingestion).

Fallback policy: primary method attempts 3 consecutive pushes over 20 minutes. If all fail:
- automatic fallback to pre-signed S3 (encrypted at rest) for 48 hours;
- we notify your security contact and retry SFTP/HTTPS on a separate carrier;
- if transfer still fails after 72 hours, we escalate to SOC/Engineering and provide a PGP-signed manifest and SFTP mirror on a secondary peering.

Checksums/attestation:
- We generate SHA256 checksums for each chunk and a manifest.jsonl with checksums.
- Optional: we can PGP-sign the manifest (your public key) and provide a KMS-attested timestamp (signed by Redwood HSM).

Attached: sample_transport_checklist.txt and sample_manifest_example.jsonl.

Next steps for us to proceed:
- Confirm transfer method (SFTP / HTTPS / pre-signed S3 / streaming).
- Provide target host and credentials (or upload endpoint) and preferred signature method (PGP vs HMAC).
- Confirm redaction policy (if actor ids should be hashed).
- Accept PO and timeline — standard handoff SLA is 3 business days from receipt of creds/endpoint.

Kimberly and Ben are on the thread to confirm the rollout and copy of the attestation.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Technical Account Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Susan Martin <susan.martin@northriver.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: admin activity export options + legal-hold window

Adding a few operational constraints and an explicit checklist so internal teams follow the same playbook: 

Operational notes (internal):
- Exports touching PII need a redaction review. For Northriver, if you want actor ids hashed, we will store a mapping in a short-lived KMS-wrapped vault and include the mapping only in the attested delivery if requested.
- We do not export raw session tokens; session identifiers are anonymized unless otherwise authorized.

Transport checklist (to be delivered to customer):
- Confirm endpoint + credentials (SFTP host, user, pubkey fingerprint).
- PO confirmed and billing tagged: PO#/Billing tag captured in manifest.
- Window and filename convention: northriver/admin-activity-YYYYMMDD-YYYYMMDD.jsonl.gz
- Chunking strategy: 2GB chunk max, each chunk with SHA256 and sequence metadata.
- Manifest + detached signature: manifest.jsonl + manifest.jsonl.asc (PGP) or manifest.jsonl.hmac (HMAC).
- Attestation: signed statement (EXPORT-PLAYBOOK-v2) with HSM timestamp included in delivery email.
- Fallbacks documented in manifest and in delivery email headers (X-Redwood-Fallback: presigned-s3).

Ben — please prepare the presigned S3 bucket policy and a sample PGP-signed manifest (use Northriver's pubkey when provided).

Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Security Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Susan Martin <susan.martin@northriver.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: admin activity export options + legal-hold window

Hi Susan — thanks. We can proceed with SFTP + PGP signature as Logan suggested. For the fallback, we will enable the presigned S3 option for 72 hours and will include the following files in the top-level delivery folder:

- northriver_admin-20260125-20260224-part-001.jsonl.gz
- northriver_admin-20260125-20260224-part-001.sha256
- manifest.jsonl
- manifest.jsonl.asc (PGP signature — Redwood signs with HSM if you don't provide a pubkey)
- audit_export_checksum.asc (timestamped signature)

I created a sample manifest and uploaded it to our shared drive (link below). We'll wait for your SFTP host details and PGP public key. ETA after creds: 2 business days for a 30-day snapshot (~45GB compressed).
